PROCEDURE change_self_password IS
 UN VARCHAR2(80);
 PW VARCHAR2(80);
 CN VARCHAR2(80);

 UN := LT_USER_SESSION.get_userid;
 PW := GET_APPLICATION_PROPERTY(PASSWORD); 
 CN := GET_APPLICATION_PROPERTY(CONNECT_STRING);

 IF :ctrl_blk_1.OLD_PASSWORD IS NULL THEN
 BELL;
 GO_ITEM('ctrl_blk_1.OLD_PASSWORD');
 show_error('0080');
 check_package_failure;

 ELSIF PW !=:ctrl_blk_1.OLD_PASSWORD THEN
 GO_ITEM('ctrl_blk_1.OLD_PASSWORD');
 :ctrl_blk_1.OLD_PASSWORD := NULL;
 :ctrl_blk_1.NEW_PASSWORD_1 := NULL;
 :ctrl_blk_1.RETYPE_NEW_PASSWORD := NULL;
 
 message('Error: Old Application password is incorrect');
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 END IF;

 IF :ctrl_blk_1.NEW_PASSWORD_1 IS NULL THEN
 BELL;
 GO_ITEM('ctrl_blk_1.NEW_PASSWORD_1');
 show_error('0080');
 check_package_failure;
 ELSIF :ctrl_blk_1.RETYPE_NEW_PASSWORD IS NULL THEN
 BELL;
 GO_ITEM('ctrl_blk_1.RETYPE_NEW_PASSWORD');
 show_error('0080');
 check_package_failure;
 ELSIF :ctrl_blk_1.NEW_PASSWORD_1 != :ctrl_blk_1.RETYPE_NEW_PASSWORD THEN
 BELL;
 GO_ITEM('ctrl_blk_1.NEW_PASSWORD_1');
 :ctrl_blk_1.NEW_PASSWORD_1 := NULL;
 :ctrl_blk_1.RETYPE_NEW_PASSWORD := NULL;
 message('Error: Verification failed, please retype password');
 raise form_trigger_failure; 
 ELSIF :ctrl_blk_1.old_password=:ctrl_blk_1.new_password_1 then 
 BELL;
 GO_ITEM('ctrl_blk_1.OLD_PASSWORD');
 --message('Error: At least one character must be different from old password'); -- Commented by Kishore on 01/17/2011
 --raise form_trigger_failure; -- Commented by Kishore on 01/17/2011
 show_error('1378'); -- Added by Kishore on 01/17/2011
 check_package_failure; -- Added by Kishore on 01/17/2011
 ELSE
 ------------ Following added by Mukesh 05/20/98 -------------
 if ltrim(substr(:new_password_1,1,1),'0123456789') is null then
 BELL;
 GO_ITEM('ctrl_blk_1.NEW_PASSWORD_1');
 :ctrl_blk_1.NEW_PASSWORD_1 := NULL;
 :ctrl_blk_1.RETYPE_NEW_PASSWORD := NULL;
 message('Error: First letter of password must be alpha');
 raise form_trigger_failure; 
 elsif ltrim(:new_password_1, 'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ') is null then
 BELL;
 GO_ITEM('ctrl_blk_1.NEW_PASSWORD_1');
 :ctrl_blk_1.NEW_PASSWORD_1 := NULL;
 :ctrl_blk_1.RETYPE_NEW_PASSWORD := NULL;
 message('Error: A minimum of one numeric character is required');
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 elsif length(:new_password_1) < 6 then
 BELL;
 GO_ITEM('ctrl_blk_1.NEW_PASSWORD_1');
 :ctrl_blk_1.NEW_PASSWORD_1 := NULL;
 :ctrl_blk_1.RETYPE_NEW_PASSWORD := NULL;
 message('Error: Minimum length of password is 6 characters');
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 elsif ltrim(:new_password_1, '0123456789') is null then
 BELL;
 GO_ITEM('ctrl_blk_1.NEW_PASSWORD_1');
 :ctrl_blk_1.NEW_PASSWORD_1 := NULL;
 :ctrl_blk_1.RETYPE_NEW_PASSWORD := NULL;
 message('Error: A minimum of one alpha character is required');
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 end if;
 -------------------------------------------------------------

 PW := :ctrl_blk_1.NEW_PASSWORD_1;
 
 FORMS_DDL('ALTER USER '||UN||' IDENTIFIED BY '||PW);
 -- Added by Kishore on 01/17/2010. IM 4668
 begin
 update system_users 
 set password_modified_date = sysdate
 where user_id = UN;
 exception 
 when others then
 message('Error in updating application password');
 end;
 -- End of change
 show_error('1379');
 check_package_failure;
 LOGOUT;
 PW := :ctrl_blk_1.NEW_PASSWORD_1;
 IF CN IS NOT NULL THEN
 LOGON(UN,PW ||'@'||CN,false);
 ELSE
 LOGON(UN,PW,false);
 END IF;
 LT_USER_SESSION.set_userid(UN);
 exit_form;
 
 END IF;
END;

 BELL;
 GO_ITEM('CTRL_BLK_1.NEW_PASSWORD_1');
 :CTRL_BLK_1.NEW_PASSWORD_1 := NULL;
 :CTRL_BLK_1.RETYPE_NEW_PASSWORD := NULL;
 message('Error: Verification failed, please retype password');

 END IF; 
:system.message_level:=15;

 decode(sign(nvl(ISBT_start_date,sysdate+1)-sysdate),1,'C','I') 
 into :GLOBAL.chapter_id, :GLOBAL.unit_scheme,
 :GLOBAL.user_testing_lab_code,
 :GLOBAL.validate_ff_value, :GLOBAL.current_barcode_default
 from system_users, chapters
 where upper(user_id) = LT_USER_SESSION.get_userid and
 system_users.chapter_id = chapters.chapter_id and
 --sysdate between system_users.eff_date and nvl(system_users.term_date,sysdate+365) and --IM:8600
 sysdate between chapters.eff_date and
 nvl(chapters.term_date,sysdate+365);
 declare
 v_local_time date;
 begin
 if is_timezone_enabled then
 -- message('TZ ENABLED');
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id,sysdate,v_local_time);
 :banner.hdr_date := v_local_time;
 :banner.hdr_time := to_char(v_local_time,'hh24:mi');
 else
 -- message('TZ DISABLED');
 :banner.hdr_date := sysdate;
 :banner.hdr_time := to_char(sysdate,'hh24:mi');
 end if;
 end;
 
 
 SHOW_HINT; 
 exception
 when NO_DATA_FOUND
 then
 show_error('0130');
 check_package_failure;
 when OTHERS
 then
 message('Error in selecting chapter_id for user');
 handle_error;
 check_package_Failure;
 end;
 
 :BANNER.PROG_VERSION := BANNER_PROG_VERSION; 
 
 
end ;
